title: Fish skeleton
prompt: A cartoony fish skeleton, but one of the ones where it is all bones except for the head which is still a fish head. I’m think if the kind that you might see in a comic book depiction of a trash can or a cartoon cat playing with or something. It should be slightly curved and the fish should have Xs for eyes to convey that it is dead lol
